subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hesitate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Falter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hesitate"** means to pause before saying or doing something, often due to uncertainty or reluctance. (हिचकिचाना)

 
 
• **Example: **She hesitated before answering the difficult question.
 
 
 
• **"Falter"** refers to start to lose strength or momentum, or to hesitate. (डगमगाना)
 
 
• **Example: **His voice faltered when he was asked about the incident.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Falter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Blabber** (बकवास): To talk in a noisy, excited, or declamatory manner.

 
 
• **Example: **He tends to blabber when he is nervous.
 
 
 
• **Recoil** (पीछे हटना): To suddenly spring or flinch back in fear, horror, or disgust.
 
 
• **Example: **She recoiled in horror at the sight of the snake.
 
 
 
• **Conceal** (छिपाना): To keep from sight; hide.
 
 
• **Example: **He tried to conceal his disappointment from his friends.
 
 

3b:Td76,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**
